title: Playbook model concept comparison

categories.label: Sports betting
categories.description: Explain something about how a sports bet works.

categories.label: Gambling myth
categories.description: Give a familiar gambling belief a fresh fact-based treatment.

categories.label: Agent’s choice
categories.description: Explore another angle on entertainment literacy.

method: Three agents were spawned with fresh contexts, different model overrides, identical high reasoning settings, and the same dispatch text except for the assigned output folder. Each was required to read the shared brief and all 19 common input files before authoring. No participant was permitted to read another participant’s outputs. Each authored and revised its own three concepts using the common renderer. The comparison records one sample per model; it does not establish a general model ranking.
